It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 16, 2020 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the provincial capital city of [[Laoag]] and adjacent municipalities of [[Adams, Ilocos Norte|Adams]], [[Bacarra]], [[Bangui, Ilocos Norte|Bangui]], [[Burgos, Ilocos Norte|Burgos]], [[Carasi]], [[Dumalneg]], [[Pagudpud]], [[Pasuquin]], [[Piddig]], [[Sarrat]] and [[Vintar]]. It is currently represented in the [[19th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Sandro Marcos]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).{{Cite web |title=House Members - 20th Congress |url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/house-members |access-date=2026-08-28 |website=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]}}{{cite news|url=https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/08/24/23/sandro-marcos-joins-dads-partido-federal-ng-pilipinas|title=Sandro Marcos shifts political party to dad's Partido Federal ng Pilipinas|date=August 24, 2023|access-date=August 24, 2023|first=Job|last=Manahan|work=ABS-CBN News}} {{clear}} == List of members representing the district == === Philippine Assembly (1907–1916) === {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" ! width="100px" | Portrait ! width="135px" | Member
